jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(6)(E) inventory: Lowell School District, a town school district in the North Country Supervisory Union (member town: Lowell). Operates the Lowell Graded School.
North Country SU Lowell School Board page (official).

sources.note: Lowell School District: three directors at-large under 16 V.S.A. section 423(a), elected from the floor at the annual school district meeting. David Legacy (Vice Chair 2024-25, gone by the 2025-26 roster) is NOT recorded -- no fetched document records his departure (missing: a 2025 Lowell School Board minute recording a resignation/appointment in the seat Delva filled). North Country SU Lowell School Board page (official): rosters for 2024-25 (Richardson, Legacy, Blay), 2025-26 (Richardson, Blay, Delva) and 2026-27 (Shauna Richardson, Chair; Jenna Delva, Vice Chair; Jeremy Pion, Clerk). The board elects three directors from the floor at the annual school district meeting (16 V.S.A. section 423(a)).

Minutes of the Lowell Annual School District Meeting, March 3, 2026 (official, Town of Lowell): Article 2 elected Jenna Delva to a three-year term. The 2025 meeting minutes (March 4, 2025) elected Delva to the remaining one year of a three-year term and Jason Blay to a three-year term (68-31 paper ballot). The board's March 16, 2026 minutes record Blay's resignation effective that night and the appointment of Jeremy Pion.

directors.name: Shauna Richardson
directors.note: Board Chair on the SU rosters for 2024-25, 2025-26 and 2026-27; signs the 2025 and 2026 annual meeting minutes as a director. Her term end is unpublished in any fetched document (missing: the 2024 annual meeting minutes or a town officers list) -- no end asserted.

directors.name: Jenna Delva
directors.note: Elected March 4, 2025 to the remaining one year of a three-year term, then elected March 3, 2026 to a full three-year term (annual meeting minutes, Article 2 both years).

directors.name: Jeremy Pion
directors.note: Appointed March 16, 2026 (board minutes verbatim: motion to appoint, approved) on Jason Blay's resignation effective that night; elected Clerk at the same meeting. No term asserted.

directors.name: Jason Blay
directors.note: Elected March 4, 2025 to a three-year term (68 votes to 31, paper ballot); resigned effective at the close of the March 16, 2026 board meeting (minutes).

directors.name: Steve Mason
directors.note: Chaired the Lowell School Board 2005-2024 (House concurrent resolution H.C.R. 193, 2024); not on the 2024-25 roster.
